action.mfa_login.description: Issue pending enrolled challenge and atomically verify TOTP/create session

errors.refused: Opaque invalid_credentials, invalid_control, connection_refused, auth crypto/clock errors; known committed Rejected vs NotCommitted/OutcomeUnknown failures

preconditions: Runtime owns actual control handle/workspace lifetime and endpoint gates; no caller identity/time/key claims
Native replay protection requires authoritative native writer; no live dual writers
postconditions: Pending cookie after known challenge commit or signed session cookie only after known MFA/session commit
Wrong/replayed code commits declared attempt/audit state; operational failures roll back or mark unknown and retire connection
external_effects: Declared canonical control verification/session/twoFactor/telemetry mutations and existing immutable lifecycle triggers
